answer_1.quote: For extractive summarization, the adversary inserts a collision into the input text, causing it to be picked as the most relevant content.
answer_1.outputs: collisions (unrelated texts that are judged semantically equivalent by the target model)

answer_2.quote: We use BERTSCORE to demonstrate that our collisions are unrelated to the target inputs.

answer_3.quote: BERTSCORE computes a semantic similarity score, ranging from -1 to 1, between a candidate and a reference by using contextualized representation for each token in the candidate and reference.
